name: Ariana Felicitas
source: Ariana is a ghost who cannot calm down and continues to wander the earth, trying to remember the circumstances of her death. She was a member of the Felicitas family, where the head was a priest with great religious connections. After Raymond fell from heaven and acquired a physical form, he found Ariana and she joined him. Together they decided to investigate the cause of the Felicitas' death. At the moment, she lives with Raymond in a house rented by Laurence Bremer, trying to uncover the truth about her past.
